cases.name: Jacquelyn Jo Rooney
cases.narrative: On 11/12/20222, during a welfare check, she was found in her apartment wrapped in a sleeping bag and covered in blankets and debris. She had been stabbed multiple times and suffered head trauma. An autopsy revealed she was stabbed more than 12 times in the torso, three separate skull fractures from blunt force trauma, and a broken jaw.
